name: Subtly Dungeons
description: Subtly Dungeons is a Minecraft mod that aims to add features that truly fit within the world of Minecraft by drawing from "canon" features from Minecraft Dungeons, abandoned base-game update plans, and other Minecraft media (and maybe the occasional original idea). The aim of this mod is not only to enhance the game for experienced players, but also to remain beginner-friendly for those who prefer a "less intense" and/or a "mostly vanilla" experience.
authors:
Developers: Kyrin Betts 
 Visual Artists: Kyrin Betts, Aldin Besic
